87:t_1:7.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「Why won't you take me with you?」

87:t_1:8.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Please understand, Miss $$ソシエ$$. This battle will be different from the ones before.」

87:t_1:9.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「I've fought beside you all this time, $$ロラン$$! We've survived every major battle so far, haven't we!?」

87:t_1:10.en:
$$メシェー$$
「Stop it, $$ソシエ$$. $$ロラン$$ is thinking of you...」

87:t_1:11.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「Stay out of this, $$メシェー$$!」

87:t_1:13.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「Tell me why, $$ロラン$$! Why!?」

87:t_1:14.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...I understand that you want to fight with the resistance...」

87:t_1:15.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But if we keep going, we'll face a battle more terrible than anything we've seen.」

87:t_1:17.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「What is that supposed to mean!? Did you get some prophecy in a dream!?」

87:t_1:18.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...The $$ホワイトドール$$... is telling me that...」

87:t_1:20.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I can't explain it well, but when I fight $$サイデリアル$$ in the $$ホワイトドール$$, that's what I feel.」

87:t_1:21.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「Stop it! You're just letting a mechanical doll push you around!」

87:t_1:23.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「Then don't go! If it's that dangerous, you don't have to fight, either, $$ロラン$$!」

87:t_1:25.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Lady $$ディアナ$$... entrusted the $$ホワイトドール$$ to me.」

87:t_1:26.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「What!? You'll listen to Lady $$ディアナ$$, but you won't listen to me!?」

87:t_1:28.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「Fine! Go wherever you want, then! As of today, you're fired, $$ロラン$$!」

87:t_1:29.en:
$$ロラン$$
「...Thank you for everything you've done for me.」

87:t_1:31.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Miss $$キエル$$... Please look after Miss $$ソシエ$$.」

87:t_1:32.en:
$$キエル$$
「I'm the head of the $$ハイム$$ family now. I'm the one who decides whom we employ.」

87:t_1:33.en:
$$キエル$$
「$$ロラン$$... Make sure you come back alive.」

87:t_1:36.en:
$$メシェー$$
「I understand how you feel, $$ソシエ$$. But this time...」

87:t_1:37.en:
$$キエル$$
「$$ソシエ$$... Try to understand how $$ロラン$$ feels, too...」

87:t_1:40.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「$$ロラン$$... Please come back... Whatever happens to you, please...」

87:t_1:41.en:
$$キエル$$
(Lady $$ディアナ$$... As you force $$ロラン$$ down this harsh road, are you tormenting yourself as well...?)

87:t_1:42.en:
$$キエル$$
(Lady $$ディアナ$$... Please find peace in your heart...)

87:t_1:46.en:
$$トッポ$$
「Good work, Sis $$レイカ$$. Thanks for showing them the way.」

87:t_1:47.en:
$$レイカ$$
「You too, $$トッポ$$ and $$ビューティ$$. How are things going?」

87:t_1:48.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「The resistance leaders are all here. Everyone's raring to go.」

87:t_1:49.en:
$$リリ$$
「So these are the people who will form the core of this operation.」

87:t_1:51.en:
$$リリ$$
「My name is $$リリ・ボルジャーノ$$. I represent the resistance. It's a pleasure to meet you.」

87:t_1:52.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「My apologies. I'm Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$.」

87:t_1:53.en:
$$リリ$$
「Please don't worry. I'm used to people being surprised.」

87:t_1:54.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「But Miss $$リリ$$'s judgment, negotiating skills... and charisma make her a worthy leader for us.」

87:t_1:55.en:
$$リリ$$
「Thank you. But I'll leave the front lines to all of you.」

87:t_1:56.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Understood. We'll handle the operational planning.」

87:t_1:57.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We're $c, an independent unit from $$蒼の地球$$. We're counting on your support.」

87:t_1:58.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「We know a fair bit about you.」

87:t_1:60.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「I'm from $$ＵＣＷ$$. I remember $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$'s battles.」

87:t_1:61.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「I'm from $$ＡＤＷ$$, but $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$'s deeds gave me courage many times.」

87:t_1:62.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「$$ビューティ$$ told us you're something like a combined force of $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

87:t_1:63.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「That's why we've put our hopes in this operation, with your participation.」

87:t_1:65.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「But it's not bad to have people expecting things of us.」

87:t_1:66.en:
$$マオ$$
「Everyone would say that living up to those expectations is what $c does.」

87:t_1:67.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Exactly. We've got to do it.」

87:t_1:68.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Morale is high in every unit. We'll use that momentum to take $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

87:t_1:69.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「I'll explain the situation. Then let's decide where each team will deploy.」

87:t_1:70.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
($$セントラル・ベース$$, where the $$アメリア$$ Continent's $$レイライン$$s converge... Will this battle decide the war on $$翠の地球$$...?)

87:t_1:74.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

87:t_1:75.en:
$$アルト$$
「...So $$翠の地球$$ has a network of $$レイライン$$s just like $$蒼の地球$$...」

87:t_1:76.en:
$$マオ$$
「On $$蒼の地球$$, the $$レイライン$$s converge at the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$, but...」

87:t_1:77.en:
$$マオ$$
「Here, they converge at local $$ターミナル・ベース$$s, then feed into a large base on each continent.」

87:t_1:78.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's $$セントラル・ベース$$, then.」

87:t_1:79.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$翠の地球$$ had no unified organization like a federal government. By spreading a network of local bases, they could control the whole planet.」

87:t_1:80.en:
$$マオ$$
「But each point has little military strength. By defeating them one by one, we can break their control.」

87:t_1:81.en:
$$宗介$$
「To do that, we need to break the connections between those points... In other words, disrupt the enemy's coordination.」

87:t_1:82.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's what the assault on $$セントラル・ベース$$ is for.」

87:t_1:83.en:
$$マオ$$
「Earth's forces have already taken the $$セントラル・ベース$$ overseeing the north of the Central Continent, the largest on $$翠の地球$$.」

87:t_1:84.en:
$$マオ$$
「Even with superior forces, $$サイデリアル$$'s broken chain of command has forced it into a stalemate with the resistance.」

87:t_1:85.en:
$$甲児$$
「So $$セントラル・ベース$$ is the key to $$サイデリアル$$'s strategy.」

87:t_1:86.en:
$n
「And if we take it, we can shut down the $$レイライン$$s and stop the extraction of $$次元力$$.」

87:t_1:87.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's two birds with one stone for us.」

87:t_1:88.en:
$$レド$$
「What's the plan for the assault?」
